messages.author: fb26a7b3574f96fc
messages.subject: Fortify spatial polygons error
parts:
Dear Group,

After using it successfully many times, the fortify() function has
started giving me the following error:

"gbmap <- fortify(Districts, region="District_1")
Loading required package: rgeos
Loading required package: stringr
rgeos: (SVN revision 235)
GEOS runtime version: 3.2.2-CAPI-1.6.2
Polygon checking: TRUE
WARNING! if you turn polygon checking off, and polygons are
not valid in GEOS, you risk losing data as your R session may crash!


Attaching package: 'rgeos'

The following object(s) are masked from 'package:gpclib':

append.poly, area.poly, get.bbox, get.pts, read.polyfile,
scale.poly, triangulate, tristrip, write.polyfile

Error in unionSpatialPolygons(cp, invert(polys)) :
could not find function "version_GEOS0"
In addition: Warning message:
In library(package, lib.loc = lib.loc, character.only = TRUE,
logical.return = TRUE, :
there is no package called 'stringr' "

"gbmap" was created by reading in a shapefile with the readShapePoly()
function. As I said up until now I have been using fortify routinely
on this object without any problems. Any suggestions would be greatly
appreciated.

Many thanks,

James
